entry_points.text: Native page-table init aliases generic paging init.
Machine table provides restart, halt, power-off, shutdown, crash shutdown with frame and emergency restart; selectors distinguish BIOS and APM with shutdown observer carrying CPU and frame.

exports.text: Pkeys report enablement and limit, allocate first clear key, test allocation except reserved execute-only key, and free keys; PKRU writer skips unchanged or disabled updates, default restorer reloads init, execute-only and mprotect resolvers return defaults when off else delegate; VMA flags combine per-key bits.

Posted ops give atomic test set clear for ON, SN and request bits plus plain accessors, emptiness check and harvest snapshotting words then clearing only nonempty ones; preempt need is cleared top bit with set clear test, count add sub with returning variants, decrement-and-test for zero and scheduler query on full counter; ON means outstanding, SN suppresses.

CR3 read masks to address, load converts via SME then writes with barrier; GS base is per-CPU offset on SMP else zero, SP0 loader writes current TSS, swap acts only on 64-bit; trap helpers get set return, instruction and stack pointers, derive interrupt state from flags, check stack containment, fetch indexed words fail-safe and resolve args from registers then stack.

hazards.text: PKRU privileged write needs zeroed companions and is costly, so gate on feature, skip when unchanged and treat missing feature as no-op.

invariants.text: Pkey, no-execute and soft-dirty collapse to zero when unavailable; key bitmap uses one bit per key finding first clear unless full; observed preempt hides need bit, updates preserve it via retry, idle writes disabled while task init does nothing; pvclock begin masks version low bit, retry detects change, scaling shifts then multiplies.
Real-mode area needs zero when allocated else page-aligned blob span with header installed from physical address.

locks.text: Pending acquisition bounds retries pairing atomic test with acquire; paravirt unlock tries fast compare exchange then callee-saved slow path on contention.

state_machines.text: Execute-only starts unassigned, allocates on first need, skips update when read already denied else denies access, frees on failure then caches; mprotect prefers explicit key, then execute-only for pure execute, demotes when execute removed, else inherits, detecting execute-only by flags plus cached key.
Boot idle offers no override, halt, no monitor-wait and poll; L1 mitigations span off, auto, flush variants, full and forced full; sampling mitigations span off, auto, full and VM write verify.

structs.text: Low bits order present through global with software aliases; masks combine pkey, dirty, cache and change sets; cache modes enumerate writeback through write-protected with index mapping to control positions; presets combine access, cache, global, no-execute and encryption into user and kernel variants; PFN versus flags split separates address and control; levels enumerate none to huge plus count; table pointer is page descriptor; PKRU uses access-disable plus write-disable per key.
ON is zero, SN one, valid one, 256 vectors with word count derived; descriptor holds bitmap plus control union as fields or single 64-bit value with six reserved words, 64-byte aligned.

VM mask is VM bit when available else zero; CR3 has 64-bit SME, PCID and no-flush form and 32-bit degenerate form with PTI user bit eleven; IO bitmap spans 64K bits with derived sizes, valid offsets, dual limits and invalid past limit; 32-bit TSS is packed legacy image reusing slot for sysenter, 64-bit holds privilege and interrupt stacks; IO state pairs sequence with overlong bitmaps trailing byte set, TSS pairs hardware with IO page-aligned and must not cross page boundary; thread holds TLS, stacks, breakpoints, fault state, IO, privilege, saved PKRU and optional shadow stack.

32-bit frame preserves general and padded segments plus accumulator and return frame ignoring high segment bits; flexible delivery packs code and stack extensions with privilege, interrupt, vector and mode attributes and union selector views; pvclock uses packed per-CPU record plus wall clock and aligned wrapper with stable, stopped and zero-based flags; real-mode header lists offsets with word-size trampoline; SME flag marks encryption active.
